creation_reason.reason: The executed batch found 2 research-only clues (cash_flow_to_circ_mv, sales_to_circ_mv), both NOT tradeable in-sample. This singleton budgets the forward PAPER-tracking family as exactly ONE promotion decision so there is no post-window best-of-three selection: only the diversified value_yield_composite_cf_sales is promotion-eligible; the two single yields are diagnostic supporting reads.

budget_policy.spend_rule: The one forward-paper promotion decision is spent when the paper window concludes with a promote / stay-research-only / drop verdict on the single frozen primary promotion construction; it is not spent by interim monthly captures.
budget_policy.no_silent_rescue_rule: No best-of-three cherry-pick, no single-factor-only promotion, no construction / horizon / benchmark / universe / threshold change, and no real-money commitment without a NEW reviewed preregistration and ledger.

planned_tests.design_summary: One forward PAPER-tracking promotion decision for the A-long large-cap value-yield family. Three constructions are tracked (cash_flow_to_circ_mv, sales_to_circ_mv, value_yield_composite_cf_sales) but only the composite is the frozen primary promotion construction; the two single yields are diagnostic supporting reads and cannot independently promote. Promote to a NEW reviewed real-money forward-live design ONLY if the composite shows persistent out-of-sample alpha AND a rolling relative-NAV max drawdown no worse than -0.15 over the paper window; otherwise stay research-only or drop. Paper evidence cannot satisfy the live-normalized ship gate.
review_boundary: This planned test authorizes no data fetch, no forward capture run, no real money, no signal search, no production / ship-gate / full-size / DataHub / broker work.

The capture runner is a separate future slice with its own independent review, commit, and per-run fetch authorization; this ledger only freezes the single forward-paper promotion decision and forbids best-of-three selection.

next_required_actions: Independent review (Codex) of the forward PAPER-tracking design slice (spec + schema + ledger + tests) before any capture work.

After review PASS and commit, a separate capture-runner slice implements monthly snapshot + backfill-as-mature capture over the frozen construction; each forward data pull needs its own user fetch authorization.

Do not select the best of the three constructions after the forward window; only the composite primary promotion construction is promotion-eligible, and promotion requires a NEW reviewed real-money forward-live preregistration and ledger.
